failed_claims.claim: Kyriakos Mitsotakis wrote that reuniting the Parthenon sculptures needs political will and that Greece will not recognise British Museum ownership or borrow parts of the monument.
failed_claims.episode_span: will not accept a loan that leaves ownership in London
failed_claims.supporting_quote: "Greece cannot accept any arrangement that would require it to recognise the British Museum's ownership of the sculptures, or a scheme that would mean we 'borrow' parts of our own monument," he wrote.

failed_claims.claim: A 1963 law bars the British Museum from selling or giving away treasures, and the museum says no loan request has been received while its openness to a deal is unchanged.
failed_claims.episode_span: A 1963 statute bars the museum from selling or giving treasures away
failed_claims.supporting_quote: The museum's power is limited by a 1963 law that prohibits it from selling or giving away treasures -- so any permanent return of the marbles would need MPs to act.

claims.claim: Krzysztof Gawkowski said the fire in Wola Krobowska was deliberately designed to disable a Starlink station and disrupt internet access including for the Ukrainian army.

claims.claim: The fire was about 50 kilometres south of Warsaw, caused no significant damage and no injuries, and ABW and police are investigating a station run by Exatel.
claims.source_title: Poland says Starlink fire was sabotage
claims.supporting_quote: The fire broke out in the village of Wola Krobowska, 50 kilometers south of Warsaw. It didn’t cause significant damage and there were no injuries.

claims.supporting_quote: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said he disliked "labelling something as sabotage versus an accident without 100% certainty, but it looks bad".
